notes.title: Have a Holly Jolly Season Hunting Bugs! - [WINTER SALE]
notes.content:
What better way to spend this holiday season than to embark on a thrilling adventure in BUGGED OUT at the comfort of your home. Say goodbye to relaxation and hello to the terror of bug infestation in a town near you. Who needs sledge-riding when you can experience the exquisite horror of bugs attempting a face climb...

Dive into the hilarious horror of battling bugs while everyone else is sipping cocktails. 'Tis the season for bug-slaying!

Play the DEMO now, or just skip it and buy the FULL GAME instead... it's on Winter Sale right now.
